# Jobstm

> Jobstm is a secure, verification-first gig hiring platform that connects verified gig workers and students with trusted companies for flexible, on-demand work across India. Built by Maikal and Taksharya Pvt Limited in Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh. Serving clients since 2011.

Also written as: JobsTM, Jobs TM.

## Key facts
- What it is: a gig hiring marketplace where both workers and companies are verified before they can hire or apply.
- Workers are verified on identity, education and availability. Companies are verified on identity, contact details and an authorised representative (PAN and registration documents, reviewed within 24–48 hours).
- Founded/serving since: 2011. Company: Maikal and Taksharya Pvt Limited.
- Location: 03 Friends Colony, Punjab Colony, Mata Chowk, Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh 450001, India.
- Areas served: Khandwa, Indore, Madhya Pradesh and across India.
- Contact: infomnt01@gmail.com, +91 9669099914. Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00, Sat 10:00–16:00 IST.

## Services
- Jobstm gig platform: post gig jobs, hire pre-verified workers, apply for flexible and part-time work.
- Vocational training: industry-specific skill development, certified modules, hands-on sessions.
- Manpower hiring: candidate screening, background verification, industry talent pools, replacement guarantee.
- Promotion activities: campaign planning, multi-channel promotion, event management, performance tracking.
- Upskill & Grow: free and premium courses, industry certifications, self-paced learning.
